images.prompt: Polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot of an economy farming game titled "작물이 정보다", presented entirely as a 1920s telegraph and market exchange terminal. Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame; the farm itself is never drawn. Composition: black background with yellow-green phosphor glow, faint scanlines and vignette. Upper left: a split-flap price board with eight crop rows, each with mechanical flap digits showing a percentage index, a thin sparkline and a trend arrow, the lavender row gently highlighted. Lower left: an observation register table of twelve plots with road-exposure bars, planted crop names, screening values and daily observation bars, one row selected and two bars glowing amber as risky. Right: a column of cream paper ticker tapes with punched holes carrying short telegrams, the newest one sliding in; below, a 4x2 grid of crop keys with the saffron key lit, and an outlined button to advance the season. Palette: phosphor green, amber warning, off-white paper. Tense, voyeuristic mood. Korean UI: "작물이 정보다", "남이 본다", "관측 등록부", button "계절 넘기기". Text constraints: the only date shown anywhere is the in-game date "3년차 가을 · 9일" with times like 14:23; do not show any real-world year, real city, country or sea; telegrams mention only local fictional places such as "윗마을 장터", "길가 밭", "이웃 농가" and the crops on the board.

Polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot of an economy farming game titled "작물이 정보다" at the season turnover. Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame; still no drawing of the farm, only the exchange terminal. Composition: black phosphor-green terminal with scanlines; a red-bordered alarm banner across the top announcing a price crash; the split-flap board mid-flip with blurred flaps, the saffron row flashing red with a sharply falling red sparkline and a large low percentage; a horizontal bar chart below showing what outsiders observed this autumn, the saffron bar long and red, the lavender bar long and green; four ledger tiles at the bottom with sales, theft loss in red, visitor premium and next-year index. Right column: a long stream of cream ticker tapes including a police report stamped in red about theft from the roadside plot. Palette: phosphor green, alarm red, amber, cream paper. Feeling of being watched and exposed. Korean UI: "사프란 시세 붕괴", "100% → 46%", "도둑 손실 −312". Text constraints: the only date shown anywhere is the in-game date "3년차 겨울 · 1일"; no real-world year, no SNS, CCTV, internet or ₩ won amounts (money is plain numbers with the unit "냥"); every clock time is a valid time between 00:00 and 23:59 in descending order; the police report is a 1920s-style handwritten slip from "윗마을 주재소" dated "3년차 가을 · 88일" and mentions only footprints and a missing basket.
